newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Guilder rates unmoved in becalmed money market.
newsitem.headline: Guilder rates unmoved in becalmed money market.

text.p: Dutch money rates stayed glued to the previous day's levels in becalmed trade on Tuesday as the market awaited fresh impetus.
Overnight guilder rates were unmoved at 3.18 percent bid, with dealers reporting slack levels of turnover.
Very few trades were effected at the longer end, dealers said, with three month guilders quoted at an unchanged 3.14 percent bid and one-year money steady at 3.34 percent bid.
The guilder firmed fractionally against the mark at 112.48 per 100 marks from Monday's 112.49.
